title: Official 6th Sem Exam Calendar & Important Dates
rawText:
Here are our official 6th Sem commencement dates:
• Second Mid Exam: 16-11-2026 (16th Nov 2026)
• Practical / Lab Exams: 07-12-2026 (7th Dec 2026)
• Sem End University Exams: 24-01-2027 (24th Jan 2027)
author: CR Karthik

title: Date of Commencement of Second Mid Exam
rawText: The Second Mid Exams officially commence on 16-11-2026 (16th November 2026). Make sure your unit revisions and assignments are complete!
author: CR Karthik

title: Date of Commencement of Practical Exams
rawText: The Practical and Lab Exams officially commence on 07-12-2026 (7th December 2026). Get your lab records and observation books verified before this date!
author: CR Karthik

title: Date of Commencement of Sem End Exams
rawText: The Semester End University Theory Exams officially commence on 24-01-2027 (24th January 2027). Prepare all units across all 6th Sem subjects thoroughly!
author: CR Karthik
